cities.name: Beerwah
cities.tagline: Glass House Mountains town beneath Mount Beerwah and Tibrogargan
cities.general: Beerwah sits at the foot of the Glass House Mountains, with trailheads, farm-gate stops, the Australia Zoo precinct, and easy access to Mount Beerwah, Tibrogargan, and Ngungun.
activities: Drive the Glass House Mountains lookout circuit
tips: Some volcanic plugs have access restrictions
Start peak walks early
Weekend parking at trailheads fills quickly

cities.name: Glass House Mountains
cities.tagline: Hinterland village among volcanic plugs of the Sunshine Coast
cities.general: Glass House Mountains village sits among the named volcanic plugs of the Sunshine Coast hinterland, with lookouts, township services, and walking access into Glass House Mountains National Park.
tips: The village is a base, not the summit
Check track closures before climbing
A car is the easiest way between peaks

cities.name: Maleny
cities.tagline: Green hinterland town of views, waterfalls, and Glass House lookouts
cities.general: Maleny sits on the Blackall Range above the Sunshine Coast, with cool air, food streets, Mary Cairncross rainforest, and wide views back to the Glass House Mountains.
activities: Look back to the Glass House plugs
tips: Weekends from the coast are busy
Hinterland weather is cooler and wetter
Book popular cafes on Saturday

cities.name: Montville
cities.tagline: Blackall Range village of galleries, escarpment views, and waterfall walks
cities.general: Montville is a small escarpment village on the Blackall Range, with galleries, lookouts over the Sunshine Coast, and access to Kondalilla and Mapleton Falls.
tips: Parking is limited in the village
Waterfall tracks are steep
Mist and rain are common

cities.name: Landsborough
cities.tagline: Rail-and-road town at the base of the Glass House Mountains
cities.general: Landsborough is a historic railway town below the Glass House Mountains, useful as a train-to-hinterland stop between the Sunshine Coast beaches and Beerwah peak country.
activities: Use as a hinterland rail stop
tips: Trains from Brisbane stop here
A car still helps for peak trailheads
Weekend markets can fill the town

cities.name: Nambour
cities.tagline: Sunshine Coast hinterland service town for ranges, waterfalls, and Big Pineapple country
cities.general: Nambour is the main inland service town of the Sunshine Coast hinterland, with access to Mapleton, Montville, the Blackall Range, and the road down to Maroochydore beaches.
tips: It is a practical hub more than a resort town
A car is essential for the ranges
Summer storms build inland

cities.name: Mapleton
cities.tagline: Blackall Range village above Mapleton Falls and Lilyponds parkland
cities.general: Mapleton sits on the Blackall Range escarpment with a village green, Mapleton Falls lookouts, and forest walks above the Sunshine Coast lowlands.
tips: Falls tracks are steep and can close
Weather is cooler than the beach
Village parking is limited

parks.name: Glass House Mountains National Park
parks.tagline: Volcanic plugs of Beerwah, Tibrogargan, Ngungun, and Coonowrin
parks.summary: Glass House Mountains National Park protects the volcanic plugs rising from the Sunshine Coast hinterland, including Mount Beerwah, Tibrogargan, Ngungun, and Coonowrin, with lookouts and steep summit walks.

parks.name: Kondalilla National Park
parks.tagline: Blackall Range waterfall, rainforest, and swimming hole above Montville
parks.summary: Kondalilla National Park is a compact Blackall Range park with a waterfall, rainforest circuit, and a popular swimming hole below the escarpment.

parks.name: Mapleton National Park
parks.tagline: Blackall Range forest, escarpment lookouts, and hinterland walking
parks.summary: Mapleton National Park covers wet sclerophyll forest and escarpment country on the Blackall Range, with lookouts, picnic areas, and hinterland walking near Mapleton and Kenilworth.

parks.name: Mapleton Falls National Park
parks.tagline: Escarpment waterfall lookout above the Sunshine Coast lowlands
parks.summary: Mapleton Falls National Park is a small escarpment reserve with a waterfall lookout and a steep forest walk above the Sunshine Coast hinterland.

pois.name: Mount Beerwah
pois.tagline: Highest Glass House Mountains plug and a steep volcanic climb

pois.name: Mount Tibrogargan
pois.tagline: Crouching-gorilla volcanic plug above the Bruce Highway

pois.name: Mount Ngungun

pois.name: Mount Coonowrin
pois.tagline: Sharp Crookneck plug in the Glass House Mountains group

pois.name: Glass House Mountains Lookout
pois.tagline: Roadside viewpoint across the main volcanic plugs

pois.name: Mary Cairncross Scenic Reserve
pois.tagline: Hilltop rainforest reserve with Glass House Mountains views

pois.name: Kondalilla Falls
pois.tagline: Blackall Range waterfall and swimming hole near Montville

hikes.name: Mount Ngungun Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Short steep climb to the best Glass House Mountains viewpoint
hikes.summary: The Mount Ngungun Summit Walk is the most accessible Glass House Mountains climb, rising through woodland to a rocky summit with views of Beerwah, Tibrogargan, and Coonowrin.
tips: Rock is slippery after rain
Start early on weekends
Carry water; the climb is short but steep
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed Ngungun car park off Fullertons Road.

hikes.name: Mount Tibrogargan Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Exposed volcanic-plug scramble above Beerwah township
hikes.summary: The Tibrogargan Summit Walk climbs steep rock on the crouching-gorilla plug, with exposure, loose sections, and wide hinterland views.
tips: Not a beginner walk
Avoid in rain or high wind
Check current park access before climbing
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Tibrogargan day-use area off Marshs Road.

hikes.name: Mount Beerwah Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep climb of the highest Glass House Mountains plug
hikes.summary: The Mount Beerwah Walk is a steep volcanic-plug climb from the western trailhead, with rock slabs, exposure, and summit views across the Sunshine Coast hinterland.
tips: Confirm the track is open; access has been restricted at times
Rock slabs are dangerous when wet
This is a serious short climb, not a stroll
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Beerwah car park west of the peak if the summit route is open.

hikes.name: Tibrogargan Circuit
hikes.tagline: Easy woodland loop around the base of Mount Tibrogargan
hikes.summary: The Tibrogargan Circuit is a mostly easy loop around the base of the plug, with changing views of the cliff faces and nearby peaks.
tips: Good alternative if the summit is closed or too exposed
Carry water in summer
Trailhead parking fills on weekends
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Tibrogargan day-use area and follow the signed circuit.

hikes.name: Kondalilla Falls Circuit
hikes.tagline: Steep rainforest descent to the waterfall and swimming hole
hikes.summary: The Kondalilla Falls Circuit drops from the Blackall Range picnic area through rainforest to the waterfall and rock pools, then climbs back to the escarpment.
tips: The return climb is steep
Rocks around the pool are slippery
Start early on hot days
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Kondalilla National Park picnic area near Montville.
